title: Click to Expand
summary: Hide details until the student asks for them: **accordions** and **flip cards**.

blocks.md: Click a row to open it. With `"single": true` only one row stays open.

items.title: Directed tests
items.md: Hand-written stimuli for a known scenario. Simple and readable, but they only check what you thought of.

items.title: Constrained-random stimulus
items.md: The testbench generates random but **legal** inputs. Finds corner cases nobody planned for.

items.title: Functional coverage
items.md: Measures **which scenarios were exercised** (covergroups, bins). Tells you when random testing is *done*.

blocks.md: Properties checked **every clock cycle**, in simulation and formally:
Click a card to see the back side.

cards.back: 6 transistors per bit, fast, no refresh. Used for caches and on-chip buffers.
1 transistor + 1 capacitor per bit. Dense, but needs **refresh**.
Non-volatile. Keeps data without power; slow writes, limited endurance.
Extra check bits that **correct single-bit** and detect double-bit errors (SECDED).

questions.text: Which technique tells you **which scenarios** have been exercised?

options: Corrects single-bit errors and detects double-bit errors
